action.prompt: Read .kiro/specs/deadlink-resurrector/requirements.md and compare its acceptance list against the tests in src/main.rs. Report any requirement with no matching test, and any test result from the last cargo test run that does not pass. Do not change code in this step; report only.

hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, re-check the requirements acceptance list against the tests before the work is called done.
hooks.name: spec-check-after-task
